findings.evidence: Inventory of page: <nav> at line 11 contains two links (/plan and /accessibility). No <form role="search">, no sitemap link, no breadcrumb structure, no related-links list element found anywhere on the page. The page's content (service updates for a transit agency) does not indicate this is a linear process step.
findings.fix: Add at least one additional independent navigation mechanism, such as a site search form, a breadcrumb trail showing the current page's location in the site hierarchy, a sitemap link, or a related-links list linking to other relevant pages on the site.
findings.violation: The page exposes only one navigation mechanism (the primary navigation menu), with no search form, sitemap link, breadcrumb trail, or related-links list; at least two independent mechanisms are required unless the page is part of a linear process.
